post.description:
Propose an action and get the policy engine's decision.

- `allow`: the action ran; `cart` is the new cart.
- `reject`: nothing changed; `error` says why.
- `confirm`: nothing changed yet; ask the customer, then confirm or cancel
  using `pending_action_id`.
- `escalate`: the session has been handed to a person.

Send what the customer said and get the agent's reply.

The agent may use several tools before it answers. Each tool's effect is
saved as it happens, and the reply comes with the cart as it now stands.
A session ended for abuse takes no more messages (409).

with the same key returns the same order instead of an error.
